title: Cartwise Rewards Partner Credits on Cartwise+ Membership Past-Due Settlements
content:
A partner credit taken off a Cartwise+ Membership past-due settlement follows the member's Cartwise Rewards tier.

| Member's Cartwise Rewards tier | Partner credit taken off (USD) |
|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 0.50 |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver or Bronze | 0.25 |
| any other tier, or no Cartwise Rewards account | 0.00 |

The tier is read from the member's Cartwise Rewards account as it stands today. The credit is a fixed amount in US dollars.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- Cartwise Rewards Gold member: 0.50 is taken off.
- Cartwise Rewards Silver member: 0.25 is taken off.
- A customer with no Cartwise Rewards account: 0.00 is taken off.
